messages:
maria: Morning — quick async stand-in:

maria: Yesterday: rolled out prewarm change to the EU GPU pool, saw ~12% lower cold-starts in canary (ams1). Cleared two provisioning tickets (INC-3456, TKT-7890).

aj: nice. did you push the config for the new autoscale threshold?

maria: pushed to infra-config repo, PR 987. PTAL @aj

aj: looking now. one nit in the autoscale doc, otherwise LGTM.

leo: FYI spot eviction rate spiked in apac last night. ops-oncall had to failover a couple of lanes.

ops-oncall: dropped a note in the incident channel + ran the fallback script: `scripts/fallback/resize.sh --region apac --to reserved-2` — stable after that. Root cause looks like provider-side maintenance.

sophia: are quotas impacted for customer-dedicated clusters in apac?

maria: short term no, but I'm flagging: we have ~10% headroom less in apac than expected. Requesting a temporary quota bump from cloud; filing with infra-ops.

aj: can you paste the quota request text so I can approve? Want to include the throughput numbers.

maria: sure —
``
Request: Temporary GPU quota increase in apac region
Reason: Spot eviction caused reduced available prewarm lanes; need +8 GPUs for 48h to preserve SLA
Metrics: avg qps 1200, p95 latency 180ms, current reserved 42, required 50
``

leo: runbook note: if quota is denied, fallback is routing ~30% of requests to eu-west until backlog clears. I can add a weighted routing policy tomorrow.

sophia: blocker: I need CR review on the canary telemetry change (PR 992) before we promote to prod — it's blocking the full rollout plan.

aj: I'll take PR 992 after I finish the autoscale doc fix. ETA 1h.

infra-bot: Deploy [prewarm-canary] finished in ams1 at 2026-03-18T09:32:12Z :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks infra-bot. Today: follow up on quota ticket, finish rollouts once PRs are merged, update runbook to include the apac fallback mapping, and sync with support on impacted customers.

sophia: working on the telemetry CR, will ping when ready.

ops-oncall: will keep an eye on apac spot signals, set alert threshold to 3 evictions/min.

leo: I'll draft the weighted routing patch and assign to @maria for validation.

aj: quick Q — can we temporarily lower batching threshold on apac to reduce p95? Worth testing?

maria: good idea. I'll run a small experiment on canary lanes (2 nodes) this afternoon and post results here.

sophia: thanks. no other blockers from my side.

maria: OK team, drop any async updates here. I'll update the ticket once cloud responds. :rocket:
